title: 왜 늦었어요? 말로 이유 말하기: -어 가지고
objective: By the end, you can make the -아/어/해 가지고 form correctly. You can also use it in casual speech to give a reason or to say that you did one thing and then used the result.
summary: This worksheet teaches the spoken pattern -어 가지고, which gives a reason or links two steps in order.

task.title: Use -어 가지고 correctly
task.line: Write the right form, decide what it means, or choose the correct sentence.

forms.when: The last vowel of the stem is ㅏ or ㅗ (사다 → 사 가지고).
forms.means: Sequence or reason, depending on the verb and context (the vowel form does not decide the meaning). In this example it is a sequence: you do A, then do B with the result of A.
forms.exampleMeaning: I bought some fruit at the market and brought it.

forms.when: The last vowel of the stem is anything other than ㅏ or ㅗ (마시다 → 마셔 가지고).
forms.means: Reason or sequence, depending on the verb and context (the vowel form does not decide the meaning). In this example it is a reason: A happened, so B happened.
forms.example: 어제 술을 많이 마셔 가지고 머리가 아파요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I drank a lot yesterday, so I have a headache.

forms.when: Use this with 하다 words (피곤하다 → 피곤해 가지고).
forms.means: Reason or sequence, depending on the verb and context (the vowel form does not decide the meaning). In this example it is a reason: A happened, so B happened.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was so tired that I went to bed early.

forms.when: Irregular verbs change the same way they do with -어서 (춥다 → 추워, 모르다 → 몰라).
forms.means: Reason or sequence, depending on the verb and context (the form does not decide the meaning). In this example it is a reason: A happened, so B happened.
forms.example: 날씨가 너무 추워 가지고 밖에 안 나갔어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: It was too cold, so I didn't go out.

watchOut: 늦게 일어났어 가지고 (X) → 늦게 일어나 가지고 (O): Never put the past tense before -어 가지고. Show the past tense at the end of the sentence instead.
비가 와 가지고 우산 가져가세요 (X) → 비가 오니까 우산 가져가세요 (O): If you are giving a reason, don't end the sentence with a request or a suggestion. Use -(으)니까 instead.
(in a formal email) 일이 생겨 가지고 (X) → 일이 생겨서 (O): -어 가지고 is casual spoken Korean. In writing or formal speech, use -어서.
exercises: Write the -어 가지고 form of the word in brackets: ① 오늘 아침에 늦게 ____ 회사에 늦었어요. (일어나다) ② 방을 깨끗하게 ____ 기분이 좋아요. (청소하다) ③ 김치찌개가 너무 ____ 물을 많이 마셨어요. (맵다)
Fill in the blank. Use -어 가지고 to show that one step came after another: 도서관에서 책을 ____ 집에서 읽었어요. (빌리다)
Does -어 가지고 give a reason or a sequence? Write Reason or Sequence: ① 감기에 걸려 가지고 학교에 못 갔어요. ② 반찬을 만들어 가지고 냉장고에 넣었어요. ③ 버스를 놓쳐 가지고 택시를 탔어요.
Choose the correct sentence: ⓐ 어제 바빴어 가지고 전화를 못 했어요. ⓑ 어제 바빠 가지고 전화를 못 했어요.
Choose the better form for the blank: 길이 ____ 지하철을 타세요. (막혀 가지고 / 막히니까)
Answer in Korean. Use -어 가지고 and the words in brackets: A: 왜 그렇게 피곤해 보여요? B: ____ 잠을 못 잤어요. (밤에 아기가 울다)
answers: ① 일어나 가지고 ② 청소해 가지고 ③ 매워 가지고
① Reason ② Sequence ③ Reason
ⓑ 어제 바빠 가지고 전화를 못 했어요.
밤에 아기가 울어 가지고 잠을 못 잤어요.
